preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the binary string n must be between 2 and 100.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i < r_i <= n for l_i, r_i in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices l_i and r_i within the bounds of the string length.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The binary string s must only contain the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query, the output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating the existence of a good subsequence.

postconditions.expression: any(s[l_i-1:r_i] in s for l_i, r_i in queries)
postconditions.description: If a good subsequence exists for a query, the output must be 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: not any(s[l_i-1:r_i] in s for l_i, r_i in queries)
postconditions.description: If no good subsequence exists for a query, the output must be 'NO'.
